bias.en: Turning bullish · stalling at the Oct 12 high
bias.zh: 转多 · 在 10月12日高点下方徘徊

read.en: Amazon slipped 0.1% on Oct 21 to $262.37, trading between $259.29 and $264.35. It is above its rising 5-day ($258.4), 10-day ($258.1) and 30-day ($253.8) averages, the falling 100-day ($252.0) and the rising 200-day ($243.2). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5 and is above zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 19 ($249.27), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月21日下跌 0.1%，收于 $262.37，盘中区间 $259.29–264.35。股价位于上行的 5 日（$258.4）、10 日（$258.1）和 30 日均线（$253.8）、下行的 100 日均线（$252.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$243.2）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月19日起看多（$249.27），RSI 为 57。

read.en: For a third session the close stayed just under the $263.7 Oct 12 high, with the high at $264.35, so no level changed. Resistance is $263.7–265.3, then $267.6 (Aug 28 high) and $278.6 (May 5 high). Support is $258.1–258.4 (5 and 10-day), then $252–253.8 (100 and 30-day) and $248.6–249.3 (Oct 15–16 lows, SAR). A close above $265.3 would open $267.6, then $278.6.
